items.item: Each category in the tree shows a product count, the page states whether counts include subcategories, and in the sample data every parent's total equals its own products plus the totals of its children
items.evidence: Header text 'Amounts in VND · product counts include subcategories' (page.html:107). Each row renders fmtInt(totalCount(node)) (rowHTML, line 550) where totalCount() recursively sums ownCount + children totals (line 237-241). Verified against sample data: Electronics ownCount 12 + Mobile phones 323 + Computers 257 + Audio 181 + Cameras 38 = 811, matching the displayed '811' in the tree/screenshot.

items.item: The tree exposes its structure to screen readers (role="tree" and "treeitem", or nested lists) with aria-expanded on parent nodes and the selected node marked, and nodes can be expanded, collapsed and selected from the keyboard
items.evidence: `<div id="tree-root" role="tree" aria-label="Product categories">` (page.html:125); rowHTML emits `role="treeitem"`, `aria-expanded` when hasChildren, and `aria-selected` on every row (lines 541-543). onTreeKeydown() (line 608) implements ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right, Home/End, Enter/Space (select), and typeahead for keyboard expand/collapse/select.

items.item: Searching by name keeps the ancestors of each matching category visible and expanded so its place in the hierarchy is clear, and a search with no matches says so
items.evidence: markMatches() (line 491) adds an ancestor's id to matchSet whenever any descendant matches; renderTree() forces `isExpanded = isSearching ? true : ...` (line 535) and filters each node's children to matchSet members (line 553), so matched ancestors stay visible and expanded. treeNoMatchHTML() renders 'No category matches “{query}”' plus a Clear search button when matchSet.size===0 (lines 526-531, 585-590).

items.item: The detail panel shows the selected category's full path (such as "Home › Kitchen › Cookware"), name, URL slug, parent, visibility status, product count with a link to those products, and the last modified date and user
items.evidence: Path (pathHTML breadcrumb), name (h2), slug ('/category/'+slug in a tag), parent ('Parent category' row), visibility ('Visible in storefront: Yes/No' and status badge) and 'Last changed by {updatedBy} on {date}' are all present (page.html:759-831). However the product-count link is non-functional: `'View all '+fmtInt(node.ownCount)+' products'` (line 786) is wired to `panel.querySelectorAll('[data-noop]').forEach(function(a){a.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();});})` (line 836) — clicking it does nothing, so there is no actual link to the category's products.

items.item: Hidden or inactive categories are marked in the tree with a text label or icon (such as "Hidden"), not only by greying out
items.evidence: Tree row: `(node.status==='inactive'?'Inactive':'')` (page.html:549), visible on 'Cameras' and 'Automotive' in the screenshot. Detail panel also shows an explicit 'Inactive' badge (statusBadgeHTML, line 730) and a 'Visible in storefront: No' text row (line 779).

items.item: Deleting a category that still has products or subcategories is blocked or requires choosing where to move them, and the confirmation names the category and the counts affected
items.evidence: openDeleteDialog() (page.html:866) checks `blockedChildren`/`blockedProducts` and, if either is true, blocks deletion entirely via openInfoDialog('Can’t delete this category', "Can’t delete {name}: it has {N} subcategories and {M} products assigned directly. Move or remove them first.") — naming the category and both affected counts; only an empty leaf category reaches the actual delete confirm dialog.

items.item: A category can be given a new parent without drag-and-drop (a parent picker or "Move to…" action), and the picker excludes the category itself and its own descendants
items.evidence: Overflow menu item `#act-move` ('Move to…', page.html:819) opens openMovePanel() (line 1137), which builds `excluded=new Set([node.id].concat(collectDescendantIds(node)))` and filters `candidates` with `!excluded.has(n.id)` (lines 1138-1143) before rendering a searchable listbox (`role="listbox"`) — a picker UI, not drag-and-drop.

items.item: Selecting another category while the detail form has unsaved edits asks to save or discard first
items.evidence: guardNavigation() (page.html:416) checks `editing&&editDirty` and calls openConfirm({title:'You have unsaved changes',body:'Leave without saving?',confirmLabel:'Leave page',cancelLabel:'Stay', destructive:true, ...}); it wraps every selection path (tree click/keyboard Enter-Space, breadcrumb 'data-goto', add-subcategory). Note: the dialog offers Leave/Stay (discard vs. cancel-to-keep-editing) rather than a direct in-dialog Save button, but it does gate navigation on the dirty state.

items.item: With nothing selected the detail panel shows a prompt instead of blank fields, a catalogue with no categories offers to create the first one, and the tree has loading and load-error-with-retry states
items.evidence: detailNoSelectionHTML() shows 'Select a category to see its details' + Add category button when `!selectedId` (page.html:716-722). detailEmptyHTML()/treeEmptyHTML() show 'No categories yet' with an Add category button when appState==='empty' (lines 519-525, 709-715). treeSkeletonHTML() renders an animated skeleton for appState==='loading', and treeErrorHTML() renders "Couldn’t load categories..." with a `#tree-retry` button wired to retryLoad() (lines 500-518, 578).

notes: card-in-card: the detail panel's stat row (page.html:766-770, e.g. 'Products in this category' / 'Total incl. subcategories' / 'Subcategories') nests individually bordered/rounded-md mini-cards inside the already-bordered 'Category details' section card. No other listed tells (no gradients, glass/blur, emoji icons, uppercase tracked labels, rainbow statuses, promo cards, decorative charts, hover-lift, oversized radii, or navy/indigo sidebar) were found — consistent with audit.json's clean no-gradient/no-backdrop-blur/emoji-icon results. Separately from the checklist, audit.json flags 10 icon-button-name violations on the tree's chevron `button.chevron-btn` elements; these are intentionally `aria-hidden="true" tabindex="-1"` decorative affordances (the parent `role="treeitem"` carries the real expand/collapse semantics), so this doesn't affect checklist item 2, but it is a real a11y nit worth fixing (e.g. move the label to the row or give the chevron its own aria-label).
